items.summary: Union Minister of State (Independent Charge) for Science & Technology and Earth Sciences, and Minister of State in the Prime Minister’s Office, Personnel, Public Grievances and Pensions, Atomic Energy and Space, Dr. Jitendra Singh today said that Mission Karmayogi represents a fundamental shift in governance from a rule-based system to a role-based approach, equipping government officials with…
items.title: Capacity Building Commission was conceptualised by PM Narendra Modi ji who had initiated a series of governance reforms soon after he took over in 2014, says Union Minister Dr Jitendra Singh
